_meta.description: SDC Phase 0 rebuild manifest. 18 tables across Project, CFG_, SUP_, RUN_, and bare EventLog. Folds the v2 data model, the v1 naming-doc backports (file paths, dropped columns, renames), and the state-machine backports (current_state_entered_at, reminders_enabled, Upload status 'failed' -> 'error') into one consolidated build target. Replaces the v0 22-table workspace; not a delta on v3.1.0.

notes.creation_order: Tables are ordered so FK targets are created before FK sources. Relation-type display columns are in deferred_relations and applied in Pass 2 via PUT/PATCH after all tables exist.
notes.folder_id: Injected at runtime by the provisioning recipe. Not included in this manifest.
notes.field_ids: Omitted because Workato auto-generates UUIDs on creation. The recipe captures and maps them from the POST response.
notes.string_length: Workato Data Tables API exposes only 'string' as a type. There is no API-level 'long-text' distinction. Fields needing long-text capacity (supplier_message, valid_payload_json, validation_summary, incumbent_split_config, note_text, details_json) are flagged in hints. If Workato introduces a long-text API type, update those fields.
notes.date_columns: There is no API-level 'date' type. Date-only fields (due_date) are stored as date_time and recipes treat them as midnight-aligned.
notes.enum_columns: Workato Data Tables does not enforce enum value sets. Enums (status, severity, control_type, scope, etc.) are stored as 'string' with the valid value set listed in the hint and enforced by recipes.
notes.default_values: Workato Data Tables column definitions do not carry a default_value attribute. Defaults (status='pending', reminders_enabled=true, etc.) are listed in hints and enforced by the recipe that creates the row.
notes.relation_fields: Relation-type columns are Workato UI display helpers only. They do NOT enforce referential integrity. All real joins use the business ID string fields.
notes.pk_naming: Primary keys use descriptive names matching their FK usage on child tables (e.g., supplier_request_id, field_id) for self-documenting joins in the Workato recipe editor.
notes.immutability: Immutability and write-once constraints are recipe-enforced; the data table API has no native support. Hints flag every immutable / write-once column.
notes.status_writer_rule: SUP_SupplierRequest.status, current_state_entered_at, supplier_display_status, and supplier_message must only be written by STS-01. Hints repeat this on each affected column. Drift between the four fields is impossible by construction if and only if STS-01 is the single writer.
notes.file_model: All long-term file references are paths (`*_path`); shareable links are generated on demand by UTL-01. The naming-doc invariant is that links are not stored as state. Path is canonical; link is volatile.

changes: Phase 0 rebuild. Not a delta on v3.1.0 -- replaces it.
DROPPED TABLES: WFA_TemplateProject (replaced by Project singleton), WFA_Cache, the SYS_EventLogs / RUN_PipelineError split (unified into EventLog).

RENAMED TABLES (prefix scheme per naming-doc v1): VER_TemplateVersion -> CFG_TemplateVersion, CFG_Rule -> CFG_ValidationRule, CFG_ErrorTranslation -> CFG_ErrorMessage, WFA_SupplierRequest -> SUP_SupplierRequest, WFA_SupplierUser -> SUP_SupplierUser. Project, EventLog stay bare.

NEW TABLES: Project (workspace singleton), SUP_Supplier (extracted from v0 SupplierRequest), CFG_FormSlotMapping (slot labels move here from the 20 *_label columns on SupplierRequest), CFG_Variant, CFG_VariantField, RUN_ManualEntry, RUN_ReviewNote.

FILE COLUMN RENAMES: every *_file_id -> *_path per naming-doc invariant 8 (path canonical, link volatile). 5 columns dropped from SUP_SupplierRequest (seeded_template_file_id, latest_upload_file_id, last_submitted_file_link, last_validation_report_path, last_validation_report_link) -- recipes join down to RUN_Upload / RUN_ValidationResult instead.
ENUM RENAMES: RUN_Upload.status `failed` -> `error` per state-machine backport.
STATE MACHINE BACKPORTS: SUP_SupplierRequest.current_state_entered_at, SUP_SupplierRequest.reminders_enabled, Project.default_due_days, SUP_SupplierRequest.due_date.

REMOVED: cross-project FKs (correlation_id, manifest_id, template_project_id columns), customer_name from SupplierRequest (now on Project singleton), 20 *_label columns on SupplierRequest (now on CFG_FormSlotMapping).
DEFERRED RELATIONS: 15 UI display helpers added in Pass 2.

deferred_relations._comment: Pass 2: relation-type display columns added after all tables exist. UI helpers only -- they do NOT enforce referential integrity. All real joins use the business ID string fields. The provisioning recipe resolves table_id and field_id from the Pass 1 results map.
